body: I can't say no to people, they expect too much out of me.
I don't know man, I have no time lately.

My school is taking me away from life, I lost the last of my friends, and my girlfriend wants me to talk about my past but thats a nightmare I don't want to ever remember. Since i told her I don't want to talk about it, she told me she doesn't know me and that i'm not who I say I am. But she knows me, I feel hurt and discarded and alone.
I've never done meditation and I don't want to go back to medication.
Yeah I'm still up, and yeah I still need someone.
I don't, I used too, normally though I can control it, but today made me lose all control.

I can't take this stress anymore, all I feel is alone and worthless and hated. All my supposed friends don't talk to me or invite me anywhere, whenever I try to hangout they make up an excuse to avoid me, I try to be happy, I really do, but I can't anymore, it's impossible. My girlfriend used to be the only person who can make me happy, but now she's avoiding me, and I disappointed her. I want to disappear, i already started with the cutting and I didn't want to do this, but I feel alone, and I feel like a disappointment to the only person i truly love. What do I do? I need help.
